high_level_description: The image is split into two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a fashion runway scene. A model is walking down the runway, dressed in a long black coat over a white shirt and tie, paired with dark pants. The model carries a beige shoulder bag and holds a piece of paper or a small object in their other hand. The audience on either side of the runway is seated, many of them taking photos or videos with their phones. The setting appears to be indoors, with a simple, light-colored backdrop that suggests a professional fashion show environment.
